path.description: Local path or URL of a JSON array of polygons. Each record has a polygon ring and an optional height.

data.description: Inline polygons. Used when path is empty.

useProxy.description: Route requests through the Jupyter server proxy to avoid CORS issues.

httpHeaders.description: HTTP headers forwarded to the upstream server when useProxy is true.

polygon.title: IPolygonRecord
polygon.description: One polygon. polygon is the ring, height is the extrusion in meters. Extra fields are kept.
Ring positions as [longitude, latitude] or [longitude, latitude, altitude], in order.
